before.contacts: LEAH Labs — info@leahlabs.com; enrollment request form on the official site
before.funding: LEAH Labs states the trial is fully funded and covers 100% of costs for enrolled families.
before.notes: LEAH Labs currently calls its B-cell lymphoma CAR-T trial open and names Minnesota, Ohio State and Missouri. Current individual Minnesota protocol explicitly says On hold; Missouri current oncology roster also marks LEAH xCAR-T ON HOLD. Both paused sites are retained in inactive_sites and excluded from active location matching. Ohio State remains listed as enrolling by the sponsor, but its current institutional trial index does not list this protocol; absence alone was not treated as closure. Confirm an Ohio State enrollment slot and site-specific eligibility with the sponsor before travel. Sponsor states enrolled treatment is fully funded. Minnesota-specific eligibility and stipends must not be generalized to Ohio State.

after.title: Fully funded CAR-T cell therapy trial for canine B-cell lymphoma
after.center: LEAH Labs / University of Minnesota / Ohio State University / University of Missouri
after.status: Missouri enrolling per current institutional protocol; Ohio State enrolling per sponsor with local slot to confirm; Minnesota on hold
after.contacts: LEAH Labs — info@leahlabs.com; enrollment request form on the official site
after.funding: Missouri: study-related initial staging, treatment and rechecks covered; up to$4000 for adverse events and a$2000 stipend for future/additional VHC treatment upon completion. Sponsor describes Ohio enrollment as fully funded; confirm the current Ohio coverage and slot. Minnesota is on hold; its historical stipend/criteria are not generalized to other sites.
after.notes: One LEAH CAR-T protocol with site-specific cohorts. On October16 the current Missouri study-specific invitation and fresh Web read both explicitly confirm enrolling dogs with spontaneous CD20+ large-cell B-cell lymphoma; the older cached Missouri ON HOLD version is superseded. Missouri includes naive and relapsed patients, >10kg, clinically well, no primary GI or lung involvement, investigator bloodwork clearance, no Apoquel/mycophenolate/cyclosporine/azathioprine and at least72hours off prednisone. It combines lymphodepleting chemotherapy and xenogeneic CAR-T; at least seven visits over21days then longer follow-up. Minnesota current individual protocol remains On hold; its10-50kg and48hour rules must not be generalized to Missouri. Ohio remains enrolling per sponsor; its current institutional index does not name this protocol, so confirm the Ohio slot and local criteria before travel. Missouri-specific eligibility/funding do not establish Ohio or Minnesota terms.

sites.schedule: At least seven visits in the first21days and longer follow-up until progression/relapse.
